summary: KAN-90 delivers a focused code-review pass: duplicated user-display and system-status formatting is centralized in src/app/core/utils/user-display.util.ts, unused component methods are removed, the dashboard clock tick is reduced from 1s to 60s, artificial users loading is removed, ActivityService.clear() now clears localStorage, focus-trap visibility filtering is improved, and tests are updated with flushEffects, matchMedia setup, and new util coverage. Remaining gaps are minor (clock granularity trade-off, duplicated avatar-fallback computeds with inconsistent fallbacks).

gaps: avatarFallback / heroAvatarFallback email-initial logic is duplicated in header.component.ts and dashboard.component.ts rather than moved into user-display.util.ts (ticket deliverable: 'Verify reusable components').
evidence: New src/app/core/utils/user-display.util.ts consolidates formatUserRole, formatUserDisplayName, getUserInitials, formatSystemStatus, USER_ROLE_OPTIONS.
Removed local formatRole/getInitials/formatSystemStatus from profile, users, user-detail, dashboard components per diff.
users.component.ts ngOnInit: removed queueMicrotask artificial isLoading toggle (diff hunk users.component.ts).

gaps: getUserInitials does not trim/fallback on blank firstName/lastName unlike formatUserDisplayName (user-display.util.ts:32-39).
evidence: activity.service.ts clear(): localStorage.removeItem(ACTIVITIES_STORAGE_KEY) fixes stale persistence after clear().
focus-trap.directive.ts getFocusableElements(): filters disabled/tabindex=-1 and display:none/visibility:hidden.
Header user-email span now renders display name via formatUserDisplayName (header.component.html diff).

gaps: Dashboard hero datetime (now() | date:'mediumTime') updates at 60s interval instead of 1s — clock may lag up to 59s (dashboard.component.html:9-10, dashboard.component.ts:113 interval(60_000)).
evidence: interval changed from 1000 to 60_000 in dashboard.component.ts ngOnInit.
users.component.spec.ts replaces artificial-delay test with immediate-render assertion.
Focus-trap visibility heuristic changed from offsetParent to getComputedStyle — may differ for opacity:0 or off-screen elements.

gaps: Local ng test blocked by Node v20.19.2 vs Angular CLI minimum v22.22.3; suite not executed in this review environment.
evidence: New user-display.util.spec.ts (81 lines) covers all exported helpers.
TestBed.flushEffects() added across activity, theme, settings, app specs for effect persistence.
angular.json + src/test-setup.ts adds matchMedia polyfill for Vitest.

gaps: Inconsistent avatar fallbacks: heroAvatarFallback uses '?' (dashboard.component.ts:70) vs avatarFallback uses 'U' (header.component.ts:55).
evidence: USER_ROLE_OPTIONS single source reused in user-form and users filter options.
Type-safe Element[] casts in multiple spec files.
Removed void user / unused UserRole imports across touched files.
No auth, injection, or secret-handling changes in diff.
ActivityService.clear() properly guards with isPlatformBrowser before localStorage access.

gaps: No inline documentation for new user-display.util.ts public API (not required by ticket description).
evidence: Ticket deliverables are code-quality focused; no docs/logging requirements in description.

findings.title: Dashboard clock display granularity reduced to 60s
findings.detail: Template binds now() to mediumTime but ngOnInit interval is 60_000ms; users see stale time up to ~59s.

findings.title: Duplicated avatar fallback computeds with inconsistent defaults
findings.detail: heroAvatarFallback returns '?' while avatarFallback returns 'U' for missing email.

findings.title: getUserInitials lacks blank-name guard
findings.detail: formatUserDisplayName falls back on blank trimmed names; getUserInitials always concatenates charAt(0) values.

checklist: All eight ticket deliverables addressed in diff (dedup, simplify, render/perf, readability, naming, reusable utils, architecture).
Run npm test on Node >=22.22.3 to confirm full suite passes in CI.
Optional: extract email-avatar fallback helper to user-display.util.ts for full DRY.
Optional: split dashboard now() tick — 60s for greeting, 1s for displayed clock if second-level accuracy is required.
